description: A container is a JSON object; list and leaf-list are JSON arrays (RFC 7951 5).

xfail.python: a non-object container value is skipped without an error
xfail.cli: a non-object container value is skipped without an error

xfail.python: a non-array list value is skipped without an error
xfail.cli: a non-array list value is skipped without an error

xfail.python: a scalar leaf-list value is treated as a one-element list
xfail.cli: a scalar leaf-list value is treated as a one-element list
